     2: name: wg-basic-gates
     3: description: "Run wg-basic's CI verification gates and test suites: fmt/check/clippy/test commands, MSRV check, unprivileged vs rootful invocation, sudo/CARGO_HOME form, upgrade-rehearsal env. Triggers: wg-basic gates, CI gates, clippy, fmt, rootful test, linux-integration, run the tests, verify change."
     4: ---
     5: 
     6: # wg-basic verification gates
     7: 
     8: Run from the repository root (`/home/sugarwookie/projects/wg-basic`).
     9: Toolchain is pinned by `rust-toolchain.toml` (1.89.0 + `rustfmt` + `clippy`).
    10: 
    11: ## Gate order (same as CI)
    12: 
    13: ```sh
    14: cargo fmt --all -- --check
    15: cargo check --all-targets --locked
    16: cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
    17: cargo test --locked
    18: cargo +1.89.0 check --all-targets --locked
    19: ```
    20: 
    21: The ordinary suite (`cargo test --locked`) needs no privilege: no root,
    22: no namespaces, loopback sockets only.
    23: 
    24: ## Rootful suites (real kernel, disposable namespaces)
    25: 
    26: Prerequisites: root, `CAP_NET_ADMIN`, kernel WireGuard support,
    27: `iproute2`, `iputils-ping` (handshake suites), `nftables`
    28: (durable/doctor/maintenance suites). Serialize fixed-name-namespace
    29: suites with `--test-threads=1`. `sudo` resets `HOME`, so use the
    30: `-E env ... CARGO_HOME=...` form or Cargo cannot resolve its toolchain:
    31: 
    32: ```sh
    33: sudo -E env "PATH=$PATH" CARGO_HOME=[REDACTED_PATH] \
    34:   cargo test --locked --features linux-integration --test <target> -- --test-threads=1
    35: ```
    36: 
    37: Rootful targets: `wireguard_kernel`, `network_reconcile`,
    38: `network_control_e2e`, `durable_owner`, `durable_restart`,
    39: `durable_backup`, `product_management_rootful`, `maintenance_rootful`,
    40: `doctor_readonly`, `service_rootful_e2e`. `durable_restart` needs a
    41: built `wg-basic` binary (real `netd` + `reconcile` child processes).
    42: 
    43: ## Upgrade rehearsal (Phase 9 old/new pair, ignored by default)
    44: 
    45: ```sh
    46: sudo -E env "PATH=$PATH" CARGO_HOME=[REDACTED_PATH] \
    47:   CARGO_TARGET_DIR=[REDACTED_PATH] \
    48:   WGB_OLD_BINARY=/path/to/phase8/wg-basic \
    49:   WGB_CANDIDATE_BINARY=/path/to/candidate/wg-basic \
    50:   cargo test --locked --features linux-integration \
    51:     --test upgrade_rehearsal_rootful -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
    52: ```
    53: 
    54: ## Rules
    55: 
    56: - Never run rootful suites without explicit user request: they need
    57:   `sudo`, mutate kernel state (in disposable namespaces), and take minutes.
    58: - Never substitute mocked kernel behavior for real-kernel closure
    59:   evidence; when `CI` is set, missing namespace/kernel prerequisites
    60:   fail instead of skipping.
    61: - Copy-pasteable per-suite commands live in `docs/development.md`;
    62:   the suite catalog (what each target proves) is in
    63:   `architecture/testing-qualification.md`.
